entries.zh: 空想；胡思乱想
entries.en: to think idle thoughts; to daydream

entries.zh: 盘算；深思熟虑、计议周详
entries.en: to think well over what is to be done; to plan, deliberate carefully
entries.notes: 西语栏缩略「loq se ha-」推断为 lo que se ha[de hacer]；官话栏[空]

entries.zh: 比较；计较、较量
entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕Spanish column garbled ('ra para con sepillo~'); only '…con sepillo' (= with a brush) legible, which does not match Chinese 較較
entries.notes: 西语栏「ra para con sepillo~」残损不成句，与汉字栏「較較」无法互证，语义存疑

entries.zh: 悬想；深切思虑、悬念挂念
entries.en: to think with great care and earnestness; to think longingly (of the absent)

entries.zh: 揆度；揣度、估量推测
entries.en: to think; to conjecture, estimate
entries.notes: M 栏「揆」声调号污损（T99），据汉字栏「揆度」与西语栏定为揣度、推测

entries.zh: 独自心想；独自思量、自忖
entries.en: to think to oneself; to reflect privately

entries.zh: 心想；心中思量
entries.en: to think (in one's heart); to ponder

entries.zh: 机心；机巧算计之心
entries.en: to think; a scheming, cunning mind; machinations
entries.notes: M 栏「机」声调号污损（T99），据汉字栏「机心」定为机巧算计之心

entries.zh: 心思；心念、思绪
entries.en: to think; thoughts, state of mind

entries.zh: 起怯意；心生怯念
entries.en: to think ill; to conceive evil or fearful thoughts
entries.notes: M 栏「起」声调号污损（T99）；西语「pensar mal」与汉字「起怯意」义近而有出入

entries.zh: 点检；检点省察、斟酌是否合宜
entries.en: to consider whether it is fitting; to examine oneself, take stock

entries.zh: 三翻五覆；反复思量、翻来覆去地想
entries.en: to think long and hard about something; to turn a matter over again and again

entries.zh: 三思；反复思量、慎重考虑
entries.en: to think much; to think twice, deliberate at length

entries.zh: 想起来；想起、忆及
entries.en: to think so as to remember; to recall, call to mind
entries.notes: 汉字末字「來/末」存疑（M 栏 lay 支持作「來」）；M 栏声调号污损（T99）；西语缩写 p̄ 推断为 por/para

entries.zh: 自思；独自忖度、自己思量
entries.en: to think by conjecture; to surmise to oneself

entries.zh: 迂拙；愚拙无谋、思虑不灵
entries.en: to think without judgment; dull-witted, impractical of mind
entries.notes: M 栏「迂」声调号污损（T99），据汉字栏「迂拙」定为思虑愚拙

entries.zh: 思忆；思念怀想、渴想
entries.en: to think with longing; to recall with yearning

entries.zh: 忆着；惦念不忘、思量着
entries.en: to think of with longing; to dwell on in thought

entries.zh: 原情；宽宥其情、体察原宥；亦指本情缘由
entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕Spanish column garbled ('pensar,san fear~'); per Chinese 原情: to pardon with regard to motives, make allowances
entries.notes: 西语栏「pensar,san fear~」不成解，与汉字栏「原情」不对应，语义存疑

entries.zh: 耽忧；忧心忡忡、忧惧不安
entries.en: pensive; anxious, disquieted in mind
entries.notes: 首字「耽/舵」存疑，M 栏 tām 支持作「耽」；西语 supenso 当为 suspenso

entries.zh: 耽烦恼；深陷烦恼、忧烦不已
entries.en: pensive and disquieted; vexed and troubled in mind
entries.notes: 首字「耽/舵」存疑，M 栏 tam 支持作「耽」
